_readme: Deployed 2026-10-03 from the committed contracts/settlement source (wasmSha256 above). Deploy transactions: upload wasm 8e37137e8639c3c831efea3862261c0b645b29e6e1d351b783d29636577c0b69, create contract cf40c296f0597a11e60bbcc0d627fad30538611f7747e36d5370888cea58ba74 — both verified successful on Horizon.
usdcAsset/usdcIssuer are Circle's canonical Stellar mainnet USDC issuer, confirmed from developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses and the js-stellar-sdk README on 2026-10-02.

usdcSacId was computed with the official `stellar` CLI: `stellar contract id asset --asset "USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN" --network mainnet` — a deterministic derivation, not a live lookup.

The deploy's actual Soroban resource fee was unusually high for a ~22KB contract (~21.6 XLM total between both transactions) — confirmed consistent across two independent RPC providers (sorobanrpc.com and Gateway) before submitting, so it was real rather than a provider quirk. Worth watching if a redeploy is ever needed.
NEXT_PUBLIC_NETWORK_MODE must still be explicitly set to "mainnet" on any deployment before this record takes effect there — see config.ts.
